data.name: Aluin
data.gender_notes: Aluin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Celtic word 'alu' meaning 'light'. The name Aluin may have been used to describe someone with fair complexion or radiant personality. It is also believed to be a cognate of the Old English name 'Alewin' which means 'kind, friendly, and welcome'. The name Aluin carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aluin usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the light of faith and the radiance of God's grace.
data.etymology: Aluin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aluin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אלואין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלואין הוא שם שמשמעותו אלוהים הוא אדוני ומלכי, מקורו בשפה העברית ומשמש ככינוי לאלוהים ביהדות ובנצרות. השם מורכב מהמילים 'אלוהים' ו-'הוא', שפירושם 'אלוהים הוא'. השם אלואין משמש גם ככינוי למלך או לאדון.

in_greek.name: Αλουΐν
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο Κύριος και Βασιλιάς
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλουΐν προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο Κύριος και Βασιλιάς'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα δεν αναφέρεται ρητά, αλλά η έννοια του Θεού ως Κυρίου και Βασιλιά είναι κεντρική στη χριστιανική θεολογία. Το όνομα Αλουΐν χρησιμοποιείται ως ένδειξη σεβασμού και υπακοής στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Aluin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Aluin originem habet in lingua hebraica et significat 'Deus est Dominus et Rex'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Dei ut Domini et Regis erat centrale in theologia christiana. Nomen Aluin usurpatum est ut signum reverentiae et obedientiae Deo.
